encounter.text: The altar chamber is silent now. The anchor spore, destroyed, has left a black smear on the stone. The bioluminescence around it has gone dark. Around you, scattered across the floor, creatures sit dazed and still — freed, but emptied. One of them, a large rat with a broken horn, looks up at you with clear eyes. 'How long?' they ask. You don't have an answer they'd want.

choices.text: Ask if there are others like this.

over.text: They nod slowly. 'Then we rebuild.' They press something into your hand — a carved token, old stone, warm from being held. 'The Warrens owe you a debt.' Around you, the others slowly begin to stir.

others.text: 'There are three other anchor points. I don't know where — the knowledge was shared through the network and I only kept fragments.' Their expression hardens. 'But I remember one thing: the network was planted. This wasn't nature. Someone seeded the spores intentionally. Someone who wanted a door opened.'

choices.text: The door in the depths. It connects.
